title: Recovery: sessions not cleanly closed last time
description: The child process disappeared along with core's last interruption, and the agent has no memory to auto-resume from — decide one by one whether to continue, take over, or abandon
continueTitle: Reconnect the backend session — the agent remembers prior context
takeoverTitle: Start a new session with a summary injected — the agent's mind is fresh, it has only read the notes
confirmAbandon: Abandon "{{title}}"? The session will be marked closed, but its conversation history is kept.
